requirements: Home must show independent structured-data update time and deployed commit short SHA.
Opportunity recommendations are append-only by date and must support All and MM/DD filters.
Daily runs append today's opportunity snapshot, including zero results, without deleting prior dates.
Recommended jobs preserve firstRecommendedAt, recommendationDate, recommendationDates, and latest currentStatus.
Applied, closed, expired, rejected, withdrawn, or archived jobs remain visible on historical recommendation dates with current status.
